[[Razorfang's Claws]] are [[unique item|unique]] [[daggers]] dropped by [[Razorfang Hazeclaw]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Gyala Hatchery (explorable area)]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 7-17 (Requires 9 [[Dagger Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15%
:[[Armor rating|Armor]] -10 (while [[attacking]])
:Lengthens [[Dazed]] duration on foes by 33% (Stacking)
:[[Health]] +30

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance and [[armor calculation#Categories|armor category]] of the inscription, it is possible to create a replica for this item with the same stats. Inscriptions on replicas affect core armor rather than bonus armor and are not limited by the bonus armor cap.

**[[Asuran Daggers]] from crafter [[Nojj]]

**[[Charr Daggers]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Tengu Daggers]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*[[Silencing]] [[Dagger Tang]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Dagger Handle]] [[of Fortitude]]
